hotels.title: Sicily Five-Star Seaside Retreat with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Dinner
hotels.description: Discover this slice of Sicilian paradise in a natural cove between Mount Etna and the ancient city of Syracuse. Mangia's Brucoli is a five-star Autograph Collection resort where lush Mediterranean gardens meet a sheltered sea inlet that keeps the water calm year-round. The setting alone separates it from Sicily's more exposed coastal resorts, offering an unhurried, secluded and truly beautiful alternative. Panoramic sea views accompany poolside bites at Riva’s Pool Bar, Donna Floriana reinterprets Italian bistro classics and Kaigan Sushi Bar offers fusion Japanese using sensational Sicilian ingredients. Multiple pools, dedicated kids’ club and a programme of daily sports and activities give guests plenty to fill the days. With Mount Etna visible from the resort and Syracuse just 30 minutes by car, the surrounding region is as compelling as the property itself.
